bio.heading: An Italian voice on the world stage.
bio.paragraph: Ernesto Giuntini was born in Florence in 1988 and began his career in 2010. Over fifteen years he has written screenplays for documentaries, short films, and branded content distributed worldwide. His work spans major brands including Maserati, Lamborghini, Alfa Romeo, and Macallan, alongside award-winning independent productions.
